1␟Bure: Bure was a major West African goldfield, paired with nearby Bambuk, that fed the western trans-Saharan trade. It was the gold heartland the Mali Empire built its wealth on, lying west of Songhai's territory.
1␟Sorko: The Sorko were a specialized river-dwelling Songhai people who lived in stilt villages along the Niger and made their living fishing for catfish, perch, and tilapia, which they smoked and traded inland.
